import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # Separator rows/columns are uniform and distinct from the background.
    rs = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rs + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cs + [w]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(c_bounds)-1)] for _ in range(len(r_bounds)-1)]
    mark = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg and v not in {grid[i][0] for i in rs}), None)
    # Non-separator foreground is the repeated object color.
    sepvals = {grid[i][0] for i in rs} | {grid[0][j] for j in cs}
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg and v not in sepvals]
    mark = vals[0]
    for ri,(ra,rb) in enumerate(zip(r_bounds,r_bounds[1:])):
        for ci,(ca,cb) in enumerate(zip(c_bounds,c_bounds[1:])):
            pts=[(i,j) for i in range(ra+1,rb) for j in range(ca+1,cb) if grid[i][j]==mark]
            if any(max(abs(i-x),abs(j-y)) == 1 for n,(i,j) in enumerate(pts) for x,y in pts[n+1:]):
                out[ri][ci]=1
    return out
'''
